notes.title: Check out our newest game: BIT.TRIP RERUNNER!
notes.notes:
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222540/BITTRIP_RERUNNER/]BUY or WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM![/url][/h1]

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER features the RUNNER MAKER level editor tool, empowering players to craft their own challenging levels. Additionally, the game introduces the exciting MUSIC MAKER, enabling players to compose personalized soundtracks for their gameplay. This innovative feature adds a new layer of creativity, allowing players to shape both the visual and auditory aspects of their BIT.TRIP RUNNER experience.

[h2]The power of the MUSIC MAKER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=QceTOml2LvE;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Brave 150+ obstacle-filled levels based on the classic games – each more challenging than the last.
[*] Dive head-first into a trippy new art style powered by Unreal 5.
[*] Enjoy a fully remixed soundtrack at unhealthy volume levels.
[*] Create and share the levels of your dreams with RUNNER MAKER.
[*] Uncover gaming artifacts in the Historical Gallery – with fun nods to the original game!
[/list]

[h2]Trailer! [/h2]

notes.title: Your Woah Dave! Just got way more Deluxe!
notes.notes:
Woah Dave! Deluxe is a massive (and free!) update to Choice Provisions' hit game Woah Dave! Its features include:

[list]
[*]Two new levels, each of which will challenge even the best Woah Dave! players to rethink their strategy
[*]New characters from different games, including the BIT.TRIP series!
[*]Boss battles!
[*]New enemy types!
[*]Rideable UFOs!
[*]New tunes for your audio glands to absorb!
[*]A “Classic Mode” for all those Woah Dave! purists who would prefer their game remain unchanged!
[*]Maybe a few additional Easter eggs…!
[/list]

A huge amount of work went into making Woah Dave! Deluxe a worthwhile update for players. Tears were shed. Minds were blown. And being totally honest, I think we learned a thing or two about ourselves along the way.

notes.title: Do you want MORE DAVE?!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Daves. We've been totally floored by the response to Woah Dave across all platforms, and we've been listening to your ideas, wishes and suggestions.

To say that there are no (very near) future plans for our frantic yellow pal would probably not be an accurate statement.

Stay tuned within the next couple of weeks for news about what's next!
